confidence_notes: Gyeongju restaurant prices come from city-specific Numbeo data last updated in November 2025, based on only four contributors in the prior 18 months. Cocktail and wine coverage is sparse; estimates use about 4.5 and 3 times the local draft-beer price, respectively. Hotel averages and medians vary, hostel inventory is limited, and lodging data often excludes taxes and fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Gyeongju-specific price observations; no comparable-city extrapolation.
